summary: NSTS Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting the divestiture of its mortgage lending division, Oak Leaf Community Mortgage (OLCM), to an unaffiliated national mortgage lender. As of June 1, 2026, the bank transferred certain assets including real estate leases, vendor contracts, trademark rights, and IT assets; a substantial majority of OLCM employees were hired by the buyer. No material gain/loss or expenses are expected. This divestiture was required under a previously announced merger agreement with Brookfield Bancshares (May 12, 2026). Watch for closing of the merger with Brookfield and regulatory approvals.
